about.title: Two perspectives, one outcome
about.pullquote: [[PLACEHOLDER: a sharp guiding sentence]] Consulting without delivery stays on paper. Delivery without consulting stays busywork.
paragraphs: [[PLACEHOLDER: paragraph 1 — background and path.]] I have spent several years working at the intersection of business, technology and management.
[[PLACEHOLDER: paragraph 2 — the consulting perspective.]] As a consultant I start with the question of which problem actually needs solving.
[[PLACEHOLDER: paragraph 3 — the product perspective.]] As a product owner I carry the consequences of those decisions all the way into delivery.
[[PLACEHOLDER: paragraph 4 — what drives me.]] I am drawn to work where structure and people matter in equal measure.

blocks.heading: 3. No cookies, no tracking
lines: This website sets no cookies and embeds no analytics, advertising or social media services. There is no reach measurement and no profiling. Fonts are loaded exclusively from your operating system; no connection is made to Google Fonts or comparable services.

lines: If you contact me by email, I process the data you provide (name, email address, content of your message) solely to handle your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR where a contractual or employment relationship is being initiated, otherwise Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. The data is deleted once the purpose ceases to apply and no statutory retention obligations prevent this.

blocks.heading: 5. External links
lines: The website links to external profiles, in particular LinkedIn. Data is only transmitted to the respective provider once you click such a link. No social media plugins are embedded that would transmit data on page load.
